---
title: "Suggested workflow"
subtitle: "Module 5 — capstone"
---

Adapt it freely — the order matters more than the exact commands.

## 1. Quality filter

Count `N` in each outbreak genome and decide which to keep (the course threshold is **≤ 10 % N**).

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
for l in open("data/outbreak/sequences.fasta").read().split(">")[1:]:
    name, *seq = l.split("\n"); s = "".join(seq)
    print(name, f"{100*s.count('N')/len(s):.1f}% N")
PY
```

## 2. Align, assign lineages

```bash
bash scripts/11_align.sh              # or: python3 scripts/11b_align_fallback.py
python3 scripts/13_lineage.py results/phylo/aln.fasta
```

## 3. Tree and distances

```bash
bash scripts/12_tree.sh               # or: python3 scripts/12b_tree_fallback.py
python3 scripts/14_plot_tree.py results/phylo/tree.treefile --color region
python3 scripts/15_snp_matrix.py results/phylo/aln.fasta
```

## 4. Put epidemiology next to genomics

Sort genomes by date and region. For each lineage: where and when does it first appear? Does any genome appear
**out of place** (a lineage in an unexpected region)?

## 5. Interpret and write

Use the [certainty wording](04-evidence.qmd) and the [brief template](04-brief-template.qmd).
